label: 802.3af 15.4W gigabit PoE injector
description: IEEE 802.3af-compliant single-port injector that auto-detects the powered device and delivers up to 15.4 W at 48V over gigabit Ethernet. Because it performs real af detection/classification it powers standard PoE cameras and APs safely, but it cannot feed 802.3at 25.5W loads.

poe.note: HARDWARE FEATURES row "Power Supply | 15.4W (Max. 48VDC)" on the vendor page for POE150S (TL-POE150S) - tp-link.com now redirects to the Omada host, https://www.omadanetworks.com/us/business-networking/omada-accessory-poe-adapter/poe150s/ (read 2026-11-21). One port, so the device total is the port ceiling, and 15.4 W is 802.3af's PSE maximum rather than a TP-Link over-power mode.
